failure_predicate.name: CURRENT_CANDIDATE_FAILURE_V1
failure_predicate.eligibility_precondition: frozen positive-target case with evaluator-confirmed exact Question Plan at governing closure
failure_predicate.source_precondition: at least one DocumentHRMReasoningEngine._retrieve_chunks call returns successfully
failure_predicate.final_candidate_population: last _augment_financial_identity_candidates result for the selected native/MinerU attempt; it must equal the sequence presented at the predictor boundary when reached
failure_predicate.expected_support_match: injective assignment of every expected operand to a distinct final candidate with exact source_name, physical page, and Decimal value; gold is applied post hoc only
failure_predicate.failure: source precondition holds AND (predictor boundary is not reached OR final candidate count is zero OR expected physical support is false)
failure_predicate.current_failure_surface: all and only frozen eligible cases satisfying CURRENT_CANDIDATE_FAILURE_V1 in the next baseline phase

execution_contract.selection: instrument the entire frozen eligible cohort in the exact same order as baseline
execution_contract.temp_index_rule: each phase starts from a fresh byte-identical copy; original is never passed to the engine; copy and sidecars are deleted on success or failure
execution_contract.observation_boundary: raise CandidateBoundaryStop before delegating to DocumentHRMBundle.predict

instrumentation_contract.mode: observational-only wrappers returning original objects unchanged

accounting_contract.equation: F + P + S + Q = 60 unique eligible cases
accounting_contract.every_failure_signature_rule: each CURRENT_CANDIDATE_FAILURE belongs to exactly one normalized code-level signature or explicitly remains OPEN/INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE

required_code_signature_fields: exact source span and source SHA-256
root_cause_contract.otherwise: LOCAL, INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, or OPEN; never force generic

precommit_pass: governing HEAD exact and clean before authoring
60 unique development-only positive targets frozen before Candidate output
failure predicate, order, instrumentation, accounting, diversity, and artifact schema closed
Candidate/model/Binding calls in this precommit equal zero
diagnosis_pass: exactly 60 baseline plus 60 instrumented Candidate queries
F + P + S + Q = 60 without overlap
original page index and MinerU cache manifest byte-identical before/after
no adaptive rerun or contract mutation
